Synelnykovo Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Dnipropetrovs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished and overbuilt, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' According to local administration and residents, the majority of this cemetery was destroyed between the late 1970s and early 1980s, with the Druzhba-Dostyk park now occupying the site; a handful of surviving gravestones found near trees were themselves destroyed only about a decade before the ESJF survey. Notably, both locals and the local administration state that there was never a genuinely separate Jewish section within the municipal cemetery — a point of real uncertainty about whether this site was ever solely Jewish.
